scripts.test: pnpm --filter make-sfx-core test && pnpm --filter make-sfx-mcp test
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter make-sfx-core exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter make-sfx-mcp exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm --filter make-sfx-core publish --access public && pnpm --filter make-sfx-mcp publish --access public
